abstract: arXiv:2609.25008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I pretrained a language model end-to-end in Rust - alone, with no team, no PyTorch, and no Python in the training path - for $164 in rented GPU time. abstract: arXiv:2609.25046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Peer review plays a central role in scholarly publishing, yet verifying whether reviewer claims are supported by manuscript evidence remains a largely manual and time-consuming process. abstract: arXiv:2609.25066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human survey responses and behavioral reactions, yet unreliable simulations can mislead social science conclusions. abstract: arXiv:2609.25254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. abstract: arXiv:2609.25272v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) is fundamental to discrete visual tokenizers that power modern autoregressive and masked image generation models. abstract: AI agents are beginning to automate research and development across the AI stack, from improving training efficiency to optimizing inference.
